claims.notes: Digest-pinned exact release source establishes 67 durable record schemas from the generated manifest, 5 engine-journal/undo records outside it, 20 hook schemas, protocol 1.5, and CLI declarations; it does not promote unforced runtime behavior.

limitations: The controlled census is native print mode, including multi-invocation resume, a detached process task, provider rejection, hook block/deny, HTTP 429 and malformed-SSE step retries, print-mode SIGINT cancellation, and a foreground subagent journal; it is not interactive PTY mode.
Runtime evidence covers 43 of 95 modelled surfaces; the remaining 52 are exact-source-only.
Interactive TUI permissions, questions, steer, queueing, Esc-cancel, compaction, undo/branch switching, swarm, tower mode, and non-success process-task or subagent outcomes remain unverified.
Only the linux-x64 release artifact has runtime evidence; this is not a support promotion.
